_comment: Every key is optional: anything omitted keeps its built-in default,
so this file documents the full set while staying a valid partial config.
Precedence: built-in defaults < these top-level keys < profiles[profile].
A key that the selected profile defines wins over the same top-level key;
set profile to "" to use the top-level values exactly as written.
Paths (camera_file, output.directory) are resolved against the
process working directory, not against this file.

camera._comment: Ignored when camera_file is set. fx in px, baseline in metres.

_working_depth_m_note: Used to derive the search window when num_disparities is 0.
_search_window_note: num_disparities > 0 overrides working_depth_m; must be a multiple of 16.
_matcher_note: same energy formulation, but the pixel cost is a Hamming distance
between census descriptors, so it is insensitive to the monotonic
gain changes a projector's light falloff introduces. Needs xstereo.
Everything downstream (lr_max_diff_px, WLS, refinement) is shared.
_mode_note: hh4 and 3way are SGBM-only. With matcher = "binarysgbm" only sgbm and hh exist (StereoBinarySGBM defines just those two), and using the other two is rejected rather than silently downgraded. Note that a profile that defines 'mode' overrides this top-level value.
_profile_note: Profiles are shared by both matchers, so not every profile is usable with every matcher. binarysgbm: balanced OK (block 5, hh), detail OK (block 3, hh; xstereo accepts block 3 for all census kernels), fast REJECTED because it sets mode 3way. For a fast binarysgbm use profile "" plus mode "sgbm" (one pass instead of two).
_binary_kernel_note: Census descriptor variant. Mean-variation and star kernels are not offered: xstereo asserts on an integral image it never builds, and the star kernel needs block_size >= 7.

output._preview_note: [0, 0] = derive the colour range from the result's 1-99 percentiles.
